module: Start line marker for freeroam drift challenges. It displays nothing itself: it makes the named scene objects (markerObjects) visible at setup, hides them at cleanup, and, when the player's vehicle enters the line's radius, calls gameplay_drift_freeroam_driftSpots.detectStart(lineId). The module returns {create, cluster}.
notes: cluster: one cluster per POI (no merging), id 'driftLineMarker#<poi.id>'. Reads poi.markerInfo.driftLineMarker.{pos, radius, startDir, markerObjects} and poi.lineId; visibilityRadius = 0.
setup assumes cluster.startDir is non-nil (computes the left and right of the line); without startDir, the function fails, whereas drawOnMinimap handles this case.
interactWhileMoving is ignored when the player is walking (interactData.isWalking).
The methods update, hide, show and createObjects are empty.
clearObjects assumes self.cluster is defined (setup called beforehand).

create.desc: Builds a drift line marker (instance of C).

cluster.desc: Turns each driftLineMarker POI into a distinct cluster and adds it to allClusters.

allClusters.desc: List of clusters completed in place.

init.desc: Assigns an incremental id to the instance.

clearObjects.desc: Hides (setHidden(true)) the scene objects listed in cluster.markerObjects.

update.desc: Does nothing (the debug drawing is commented out).

setup.desc: Stores cluster, pos, radius, lineId and startDir, computes the left and right ends of the line (at 0.7 times the radius) and makes the markerObjects visible.

interactWhileMoving.desc: Called every frame: if the player is in a vehicle within the radius, triggers gameplay_drift_freeroam_driftSpots.detectStart(lineId).

drawOnMinimap.desc: Draws on the minimap a line between the ends (or a circle if startDir is nil) in blue (72,125,249).
